title_en: How to read this film — the visual language
how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

storyboard_notes.text: Front-loaded orientation stack (DD-P00-1, DD-P00-2 before CH-03; about 8 min shorter without DD-P01): give it a visual roadmap spine, an A-01 zoom-out and progress cues so it reads as an overview, not a delay. Director and educator lenses review it.

E-002 (ADR-001 R1) is PENDING: council-chair rules at P8 start. If it passes, the P01 core specifics are shown as short sync-anchored labels over CH-02 (4-step predict/inject/diagnose/fix loop, hash index = exact match only, 90 % skew example, weekly pacing, 3 projects, interview questions): at most 6 words each, Egyptian Arabic, English terms in Latin, one idea per moment, never a bullet list. If it fails, O2 stands and nothing is added. Do not author these labels before the ruling; mark shots `shown_on_screen` only after it.
storyboard_notes.owners: story-editor, fact-checker, egyptian-arabic, arabic-typographer, scene-director, critic, council-chair

sentences.ar: قبل ما نبدأ، اتعلّم اللغة البصرية.
sentences.en: Before we start, learn the grammar.

sentences.ar: في أربع حاجات هيتكرروا طول الفيديو.
الأولى: أي حاجة بتتحكم في السلوك هنرسمها، مش هنوصفها.
sentences.en: First: anything that controls behaviour is drawn, not described.

sentences.ar: stack أو queue أو offset أو retry budget لو هي اللي بتحدد اللي جاي، هتشوفها على الشاشة جنب الحاجة اللي بتتحكم فيها.
sentences.en: A stack, a queue, an offset, a retry budget — if it decides what happens next, you will see it on screen beside the thing it controls.

sentences.ar: play وpause وخطوة قدام وخطوة ورا وعدّاد يقولك إنت فين، لأن إنك تفهم process معناه إنك تقدر توقفها في النص.
sentences.en: Play, pause, step forward, step back, and a counter telling you where you are, because understanding a process means being able to stop it in the middle.

sentences.ar: لما رقم يتغير، الصورة تتعاد فوراً
sentences.en: When a number moves, the picture redraws immediately.

sentences.ar: وده اللي يخليك تفهم الـparameter بيعمل إيه فعلاً، مش بيقول إيه في اسمه.
sentences.en: That is how you learn what a parameter actually does, rather than what its name suggests.

sentences.ar: والرابعة، وهي الأهم: كل ميكانيزم هنشوفه مرتين.
sentences.en: Fourth, and most important: every mechanism is shown twice.

sentences.ar: هتشوف نظام شكله سليم، وبعدها العيب المخفي، وبعدها نـtrace، وroot cause، وfix، وبعدها نشغّل نفس المشهد تاني عشان نثبت إنه رجع.
sentences.en: You will see a system that looks correct, then the hidden defect, then the trace, the root cause, the fix, and the same scene replayed to prove it recovered.

sentences.ar: ده مش زينة. في الشغل الحقيقي، اللي بياخدوا فلوس عليه هو النص التاني من التسلسل ده.
sentences.en: That is not decoration: in real work, the thing you are paid for is the second half of that sequence.

sentences.ar: وكل شوية، قبل ما الحركة تشتغل، هطلب منك تتوقع اللي هيحصل. جاوب بصوت عالي.
sentences.en: And regularly, before an animation plays, I will ask you to predict what happens — answer out loud.

sentences.ar: إنك تغلط وإنت واعي هو أسرع طريقة تتعلم.
sentences.en: Being wrong on purpose is the fastest way to learn.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.

term_chips_for_chapter.term: problem → model → visual → example → predict → break → fix → callback → artifact

glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: Last-in, first-out structure; in memory, the call stack where function frames are pushed…
concepts.failure: Mixing up stack and heap, or recursing too deeply until the stack overflows.

concepts.def_en: A first-in, first-out collection: items are added at the back and removed from the front.
concepts.def_ar: هيكل بيانات الداخل فيه أول يطلع أول (FIFO): العناصر بتتضاف من الآخر وبتتشال من الأول.
concepts.failure: Confusing FIFO queues with LIFO stacks, which changes the traversal order entirely.

concepts.def_en: A sequential number marking a message's position within a Kafka partition; each consumer tracks the offset it has read up to.
concepts.def_ar: الـoffset رقم متسلسل بيحدد مكان الرسالة جوه الـpartition في Kafka، وكل consumer بيفتكر آخر offset وصله.
concepts.failure: Committing the offset before processing finishes, so a crash silently skips messages.

concepts.def_en: Automatically re-attempting a failed operation, usually with a limited number of attempts and growing delays between them.
concepts.def_ar: إعادة محاولة العملية الفاشلة أوتوماتيك، غالباً بعدد محاولات محدود وفواصل زمنية بتزيد بينهم.
concepts.failure: Retrying non-idempotent operations blindly, which can duplicate payments or other side effects.

concepts.def_en: A running program instance with its own memory and process ID, managed by the operating system.
concepts.def_ar: برنامج شغال دلوقتي، وليه ميموري خاصة ورقم PID، ونظام التشغيل هو اللي بيديره.
concepts.failure: Treating a program file on disk and a running process as the same thing.

concepts.def_en: A named input in a function's definition; the caller supplies a value, called the argumen…
concepts.failure: Typing values by hand inside the code instead of passing them as parameters.

concepts.def_en: The underlying fault that, once fixed, stops a problem from recurring, as opposed to the visible symptom where it first showed up.
concepts.def_ar: الـroot cause هو العطل الأصلي اللي لما يتصلّح المشكلة متتكررش، مش العَرَض اللي ظهر قدامك أول ما اتلاحظت.
concepts.failure: Stopping at the first error found instead of asking why it happened.

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
Orbiting legend orbs keyed to token colours.
The A-01 holo-city map (recurring asset, 04 §7): districts light up; routes between them.
Trunk chapter title card (riser + sting in the SFX map).
